items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A friend of mine, who has been a planner to me, his name is Ilya Lushtak

ctx.x: I think the first one was in 2002 and then the second one is more recent, from this past year. Can you talk a little bit about how those recordings came together, how you guys decided to pair up?

A friend of mine, who has been a planner to me, his name is Ilya Lushtak; he’s a Russian young man. He grew up in the Bay Area, but actually, he’s from St. Petersburg. He’s there right now, he just left, and he’ll be there for a while with his family. But anyways, he has his own record company. What do they call it?
